# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp")
smoking_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp_smoking")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results", "linear_model")
```

# Define Functions

## Get Combp Data

```{r func_count}
# prefix is "" for the primary analysis and "Smoking_Adjusted_" for the
# smoking-adjusted sensitivity analysis (both BACON-corrected in 02b)
get_interaction_results <- function(parameter, prefix = "") {
  save_name <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats_bacon_", parameter, ".csv")

  stats_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, save_name)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      probe = "CpG",
      chrom = "Chr",
      start = "Position",
      end = "Position",
      "pvalue_bacon"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(start = .data$start - 1)

  colnames(stats_df) <- c("probe", "chrom", "start", "end", parameter)

  stats_df
}

save_results <- function(stats_df, out_dir) {
  write.table(
    stats_df,
    file = file.path(out_dir, "combp_input.bed"),
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
}

# extra_args adds options for the smoking-adjusted run
# ("--region-filter-p 1.0" keeps all regions, so that each primary DMR can be
# matched to its overlapping smoking-adjusted region in 03b)
get_category_command <- function(parameter, extra_args = "") {
  # Column of combp_input.bed holding this parameter's P-values
  p_col <- if (parameter == "ptau") 4 else 5

  paste0(
    "comb-p pipeline --seed 0.05",
    extra_args,
    " -p ", parameter,
    " -c ", p_col, " --dist 750 combp_input.bed"
  )
}

get_commands <- function(extra_args = "") {
  commands <- c(
    "#!/bin/bash",
    "",
    get_category_command("ptau", extra_args),
    get_category_command("interact", extra_args)
  )

  commands
}

get_combp_stats <- function(prefix = "") {
  ptau_df <- get_interaction_results("ptau", prefix)
  interact_df <- get_interaction_results("interact", prefix)

  interact_df <- interact_df[match(ptau_df$probe, interact_df$probe), ]
  ptau_df$interact <- interact_df$interact
  stats_df <- ptau_df %>%
    dplyr::select("chrom", "start", "end", "ptau", "interact", "probe") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(.data$chrom %in% c("chrX", "chrY"))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$chrom, .data$start)

  stats_df
}

# Primary analysis: inputs and commands in data/combp/
# Smoking_Adjusted: inputs and commands in data/combp_smoking/
compile_combp_data <- function(prefix = "", out_dir = data_dir, extra_args = "") {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  stats_df <- get_combp_stats(prefix)
  save_results(stats_df, out_dir)

  writeLines(get_commands(extra_args), file.path(out_dir, "combp_commands.sh"))
}
```

# Create Commands

```{r run}
compile_combp_data()
```

# Create Commands, Smoking Adjusted

```{r run_smoking}
compile_combp_data(
  prefix = "Smoking_Adjusted_",
  out_dir = smoking_dir,
  extra_args = " --region-filter-p 1.0"
)
```
